result.title: Not All Is Lost: Repairing Lossy User Preference States of Personalization Encoders
result.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Author-prepared archival version with expanded discussion and interpretation. 59 pages, including references and appendices
result.summary: Personalization encoders compress evolving interaction histories into preference states used to rank items or condition text generation. A task head operating only on this state can miss useful evidence that remains in the frozen encoder's cached representations for individual timesteps. We study this recoverability gap and propose REPAIR, which compares cached representations with the current preference state in a compact learned coordinate space. It resolves corrective evidence over extended history, recent interactions, and localized bursts. It then selects which patterns at which timesteps contribute and adds their aggregate correction to the state before the task head. Encoder-host repair reuses representations from the existing forward computation without re-encoding the history. Across MovieLens, PENS, MIND, and Amazon Reviews 2023, training only REPAIR improves MRR and nDCG@10 for all twelve representative recommendation hosts while both encoder and task head remain frozen. Head-only finetuning of the same hosts yields smaller gains. For example, Mamba4Rec on MovieLens gains 3.96 MRR points, compared with 0.19 from head-only finetuning. Rank and temporal diagnostics support a compact, host-dependent corrective structure. In personalized generation, IMPerSumm improves the two reported weighted PerSEval variants, which assess responsiveness to user preference, by up to 25.23%. These results support post-compression state correction and distinguish the availability of preference evidence from its downstream use.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究个性化编码器压缩交互历史造成的偏好状态信息损失，提出 REPAIR：在冻结编码器缓存表示与当前状态之间学习紧凑坐标空间，挑选特定时间步模式并聚合修正量加回状态，仅训练该修正模块即可提升推荐与个性化生成指标。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「压缩状态丢失了缓存中仍可恢复的证据」这一诊断与 LVR 中视觉信息坍缩、latent 状态可用性及内容未被子任务头使用的关切可能同构；时间步/局部片段筛选机制可为 LVR 的证据筛选与贡献分配提供核查线索，但需确认其是否真属推理期状态更新而非仅任务头前的表示修补。
